I checked the assertions by reading the code against each TC, so `fe_test` in the orchestrator is the real check. **Files changed (all within `allowed_files`)** - `source-fe/src/components/customerEditForm.js` (new): exports `renderCustomerEditForm(customer, fieldErrors = {})`. It builds the edit form per D10. Every dynamic value goes through `escapeHtml`, and an error appears directly under its input with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`. Keys other than `name`, `email` and `phone` are ignored. - `source-fe/test/customerEditForm.test.js` (new): TC-76, TC-77, TC-78, TC-79, TC-80 and TC-81, each with the TC code at the start of the test name. TC-77 and TC-79 loop over their test-data rows inside one test. - `source-fe/index.html`: adds `
` between `#message` and `#customers`, plus the `.field` CSS rule. - `source-fe/src/main.js`: the three delegated handlers from D12. Clicking "Sửa" loads the customer with `getCustomer` and opens the form. Submitting calls `updateCustomer`, then refreshes the list on success. On `ApiError` with field errors, it re-renders the form with the entered values and focuses the first invalid input. Other errors show "Không lưu được khách hàng." and keep the form as it is. Cancel clears the form. The create-form handler and `refresh()` are unchanged. **Decisions to know about** - An empty-string error message is treated as no error, because the code checks truthiness. - `questions.md` was not touched, because I found no gap in the design. - The focus behaviour in `main.js` has no unit test, consistent with R11 in the design.
